title: Multiplicativity of the Walsh characters
statement:
Fix $n$ and a subset $S \subseteq [n]$, and let $\chi_S(x) = \prod_{i \in S}(-1)^{x_i}$ be the associated Walsh character on the hypercube $\{0,1\}^n$. Then for all $x, y \in \{0,1\}^n$,
\[
  \chi_S(x \oplus y) \;=\; \chi_S(x)\,\chi_S(y),
\]
where $x \oplus y$ denotes the componentwise XOR.
hypotheses_covered: points x, y in the hypercube {0,1}^n
replaced:
